name: Solana
rootCause: A large-scale incident of currency theft occurred on the Solana public chain, and a large number of users were transferred SOL and SPL tokens without their knowledge. According to SlowMist MistTrack statistics, more than 8,000 Solana wallets have been stolen so far. Assets are valued at approximately $4.5 million.
